# Architecture

- Use the App Router in `app/`. Pages and layouts are Server Components; add `'use client'` only to components that need state, effects or browser APIs. Expose an environment variable to the browser only through the `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefix, and never for a secret. Why: Server Components keep secrets and data fetching on the server and send less JavaScript to the browser.
- Change the schema only through migration files committed with the code; never alter tables by hand. Pass values as query parameters, never by concatenating them into SQL. Why: Migrations rebuild the same schema in every environment, and parameters prevent SQL injection.
